messages:
sasha: quick follow-up on RFC-142 (interface thinning). can we gate the Enricher->Router contract shrink this quarter? i think we can land the minimal adaptor + canary.

dan: are we sure about the migration path for per-tenant routing? main risk is kv-cache ownership and cold-warm cache stamps.

maria: i left a note in the RFC comments — rollback = feature-flag + dual-write for 2w. also requires a tiny shim in session-proxy to translate the old envelope.

leo: dual-write on the hotpath worries me — sync dual-write will add p99. propose: async mirror + read-through fallback for the first pass.

akshay: async mirror + fallback is fine, but we lose read-after-write for some flows. which customers need RYW guarantees? @maria can you confirm?

maria: two enterprise customers (acme-inc, atlasco) need ~2s RYW. plan: special-case them behind a sync flag (opt-in). fallback default stays async.

dan: ops check — can Dedicated pools absorb bursts if we enable sync for those tenants? if not, we'll need capacity gating + autoscale rules.

deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/iface-thin-0302 on cluster-us-east-1 — status: provisioning

sasha: OK next steps (proposed): 1) shim + flags (owner: @leo) 2) async mirror + metrics (owner: @akshay) 3) per-tenant sync exceptions + config (owner: @maria) 4) canary + perf gate + capacity checks (owner: @dan). target: PRs + canary by EOW.

leo: will open the shim PR today. tests i'll add: rwy-latency and mirror-consistency.

akshay: i'll add metrics/alerts: mirror-queue-lag, mirror-error-rate, read-fallback-rate, and a dashboard for the canary.

dan: i'll size the capacity impact and add an autoscale override for the canary window, plus a rollback playbook entry.

sasha: sweet. if anyone hits a hard blocker while implementing call it out here and we'll convene a quick sync. :thumbsup:
